name: large_ground

name: geometries
title: Lens configurations
caption: Examples of the four typical lens configurations found in lensed quasars. The inner (solid) and outer (dashed) caustics are shown. The position of the quasar is denoted with a cross, and the multiple images for this position of the source are indicated as black dots.

name: psf_distortion
title: PSF distortion field
caption: Example of a distortion field due to atmospheric effects taken from the LSST DP0.2. The direction of the distortion is indicated by small ticks whose length is exaggerated for illustration. Each tick is aligned with the major axis of the ellipse that represents it.

name: pipeline
title: Simulation pipeline
caption: Schematic description of how each exposure is generated, starting from a Damped Random Walk (DRW) noise-free light curve at the bottom, to the final observed frame, along with the main astrophysical and instrumental effects.

name: fwhm_vs_seeing
title: Atmospheric conditions
caption: Distribution of the atmospheric conditions for each visit.

name: lc_good
title: Good light curve
caption: Example of a good light curve submission.

name: lc_blended
title: Blended (unresolved) images
caption: Example of a light curve submission where the close pair images are unresolved, thus no light curves for image A and B are obtained.

name: lc_leakage
title: Flux leakage
caption: Example of a light curve submission where the flux of one image leaks onto its close pair.

name: lc_offset
title: Offset light curve
caption: Example of a light curve submission that has an offset.

name: scores_vs_contamination
title: $\chi^2_{\rm offset}$ vs contamination ratio
caption: From top to bottom we show the cross, cusp, fold, and double configurations. The left panels show the ratio between the quasar image and total flux in an aperture vs. $\chi^2_{\rm offset}$. The right panels show the histogram of $\chi^2_{\rm offset}$ for each method.

name: scores_vs_contamination_absolute
title: $\chi^2_{\rm offset}$ vs $f_{\rm tot}$
caption: Same as the previous figure but as a function of $f_{\rm tot}$ (total flux).

name: scores_vs_parameters
title: $\chi^2_{\rm offset}$ vs lens parameters
caption: $\chi^2_{\rm offset}$ as a function of $\theta_E$ (left), host (middle), and lens (right) flux, while keeping the remaining respective parameters fixed. The $\chi^2_{\rm offset}$ values correspond to image A (the brightest) of the cross configuration.

name: round1v2
title: STARRED: distortion on/off
caption: Same as the contamination figure but comparing STARRED submissions where they turn off the modelling of atmospheric distortion of the PSF.

name: error_estimation
title: Error estimation
caption: Median of the error estimation vs true error for all quasar images.
